name: Menethil's Gift
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I watched as the human, Ras Frostwhisper, pledged his undying soul to the Lich King. He drew the dagger to his own throat and with a smile, cut from ear to ear. His body collapsed inside the borders of the pentagram. The Lich King stood over the fallen mage and with a single motion, Ras Frostwhisper the lich, was born.

<Leonid gazes at the ground and then looks up at you.>

Yes, friend, I remember. What you seek has a name - Menethil's Gift: The ground blessed by the Lich King - holy ground to Scourge.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
narrative.offerRewardText: You place the keepsake on the tainted soil.
narrative.requestItemsText: The area around Menethil's Gift is exceptionally cold.
